issue_context.title: URL's with `(` parenthesis should be clickable in the terminal
issue_context.body:

comments: See https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/16724 as an example of a similar fix: the culprit is the url regex that does not capture enough symbols.

review_comments:
Don't we need to escape these so they're not treated as a capture group?

```suggestion
            RegexSearch::new(r#"[\$\+\w.\[\]:/\\@\-~\(\)]+(?:\((?:\d+|\d+,\d+)\))?"#).unwrap();
```

I don't think we don't need to escape parentheses **inside a character class** because parentheses in this context are treated as literal characters, not as special regex constructs like capture groups. I was able to repro the issue and the confirm that this change fixed it.
